title: Qt: More off-by-one pixel fixes
description:
Always initialize QSize to avoid using width -1 when calculating
button positions in capture filter. Set drop-down button to 14px.

Align capture filter and display filter position calculation code.
Change size().width() -> width() because this is the same value.

commits_data.message:
Qt: More off-by-one pixel fixes

Always initialize QSize to avoid using width -1 when calculating
button positions in capture filter. Set drop-down button to 14px.

Align capture filter and display filter position calculation code.
Change size().width() -> width() because this is the same value.
